subject.title: Control UI chat markdown only renders data URI images, not remote https image URLs

question: Should Control UI ever render remote http/https Markdown image URLs directly from chat content, and if so under what trust policy?
rationale: Current code, tests, docs, and merged hardening intentionally prevent remote browser image fetches, while the requested UX improvement changes that security boundary.

options.title: Keep No-Remote Default
options.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob image policy and require structured same-origin media, local blobs, or a proxy/opt-in design before remote images render.

options.title: Allow Direct Remote Images
options.body: Accept the browser-fetch privacy tradeoff and update the renderer, sanitizer attributes, CSP, docs, tests, and browser proof together.

options.title: Fold Into Inline Media Umbrella
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/64607 as the broader policy vehicle and keep this focused issue linked as the remote Markdown image slice.

recommendation.title: Keep No-Remote Default
recommendation.body: Preserve the current same-origin/data/blob image policy and require structured same-origin media, local blobs, or a proxy/opt-in design before remote images render.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is closest to the Control UI browser-fetch/CSP security policy that drobison00 directly changed in merged history.
